goal: N04 raw map geometry and spatial classification
scope: Two current-source Gazebo sensor-fixture layouts; one fresh VINS epoch and three same-identity raw occupancy snapshots per layout; offline truth comparison and online VINS-map classification only.
qualification: Closes the N04 measurement and reproducibility exit. Diagnostic evidence only; it does not qualify trajectory safety, vehicle clearance, flight, or the complete GOAL C acceptance. No numeric map-error threshold was added.

validation.sdf_preflight: gz sdf -k accepted both generated layouts and their separate truth-only SDFs; 4 SDF files valid.
validation.analysis_recheck: Both evaluator runs passed on temporary byte-identical copies of each run directory and its companion stack/session directory. Class counts were identical; geometric numeric differences were floating-point roundoff only. Original Docker-owned raw run files were not rewritten.

structure_check.note: 80 absent historical artifact links were reported as optional; structure/design only, not a build or SITL check.

trajectory_alignment.method: single rigid SE(3), scale fixed to one; fit only on time-paired VINS IMU odometry and Gazebo fixture truth

debug_truth_projection_offline_only.use: truth substituted offline for the same sampled fused depth observations; never an online mapping input

fusion_timing.semantics: ROS/sim source age and steady-clock callback cost are separate; neither is service response duration.

analytic_occlusion.qualification: Offline only: line segments from interpolated Gazebo camera poses to ROI corners/center tested against static SDF solids.

obstacle_interior_classification.interior_definition: all map voxel centers more than half a voxel diagonal inside an analytic static solid

retained_setup_failure.reason: ROS setup sourcing failed under nounset before Gazebo or VINS started; no mapping sample or snapshot was produced. Excluded from geometry results.

observed_anomalies_and_limits: Sampled expected-free ray-reference cells classified raw occupied: wall layout 13, 5, 3 across its three snapshots; corridor layout 276, 4, 2. These are retained as false-occupied/voxel-vote conflicts, not hidden by inflation.
Corridor snapshot 3 occupied-set Jaccard to snapshot 2 was 0.349 and its measured central-wall median shift was 0.0982 m, close to one 0.1 m voxel; surface error remained below one voxel.
Ray-reference sampling is a deterministic lower-bound subset of fused depth frames and pixels; it does not claim exhaustive whole-map visibility coverage.
The exact evaluator cannot overwrite the original root-owned capture files as the unprivileged workspace user; validation used temporary copies containing the paired stack/session evidence.
